rule.name: LoopInvariantCopy
rule.message: This stores a new full copy of a collection or array on every pass of this loop or callback, although the copied value does not change in it, so memory grows with the number of passes times its size. Share one read-only value (List.copyOf made once before the loop, an unmodifiable view) or copy once before the loop. The cost only matters when both the loop and the copied value can be large.
